about_the_game:
Death is not period, but a semicolon.

When mortals pass, their souls could ascend to heaven for reincarnation. Yet some refuse to do so. They choose to linger in the living’s world, bound by their earthly obsessions—love, grudges, or sheer stubbornness…

These wayward are classified as "Spirit Permanent Resident (SPR)", or "Soul Squatters”. Most of them eventually fade into obscurity, but a mischievous few hone their spiritual powers to meddle with the living, birthing urban legends that straddle horror and dark comedy.

Thus stands an ancient profession modernized: 

Spirit Agent.

Paranormal Adventure Game

Ghost Hunting Journal is a narrative-driven adventure game set in the fictional Chinese metropolis of Riverun. Players control a duo of unconventional Spirit Agents—polar opposites in personality and abilities. Roam the city, switch between partners, and tackle missions including but not limited to:

  • Aberrant Spirit Standardization Protocol (Spirit Purification) 

  • Paranormal Incident Due Process Expulsion (Spirit Eviction)

  • Public Malevolence Hazard Mitigation (Malevolence Suppression) 

Main Characters                                    

  • Joe                                                            

The Couch Potato Mystic

Gifted with spiritual power, raw psychic manipulation abilities. Self-proclaimed "Platonic Guardians" (if napping counts as a virtue).

  • Jolin                                  

The Pocket-Sized Exorcist

Born with Yin-Yang eyes that see through spiritual realms. Besides the daily job of Spirit Agent, often moonlights as a viral livestreamer.

Developer Profile

                                                   

An indie game dev duo based in Sichuan, China’s spice capital. Specialize in narrative-driven adventure games that try to push the boundaries of the ninth art, with the debut The Suspected Murder released in 2024.

content_descriptors.notes: Ghost-Hunting Journal is a death-themed game that includes some mature content. Violence, murder, crime, and perversions of reality to distress are present within the game in a cartoonish style blending dark humor.

short_description: If death is just a semicolon, would you reincarnate to hustle harder, or just slack off in style? In this “GOK™” (Ghosts Only Know) adventure game, you'll navigate the shadows and unravel bittersweet urban mysteries, where laughter dances with tears. Life’s flavor? Bitter melon mojito with extra!
